subject: Vendor questionnaire: NovaCorp cloud marketplace listing - timeline & clarifications
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novacorp.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor questionnaire: NovaCorp cloud marketplace listing - initial upload

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. We're kicking off our marketplace procurement packet for Q3 listings and I've attached the master vendor questionnaire (Nova_RFP_Cloud_AWS_Azure_GCP.xlsx).

High-level asks from procurement:
- Completed questionnaire (technical + commercial)
- SOC2 summary + any compliance evidence you can share
- Typical lead time for listing and any blocking dependencies (billing, contractual)

Can you confirm a target date for returning the completed questionnaire? We're hoping to collect all vendor responses by Friday, June 4 so evaluation can start the week of June 7.

Also copying procurement@novacorp.com so they have the tracker. If there are questions on the template cells (especially the billing flow and tenant isolation sections) please flag them and we'll clarify.

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Sr. Vendor Manager, NovaCorp Marketplace
T: +1 415-555-0214

Attachment: Nova_RFP_Cloud_AWS_Azure_GCP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novacorp.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor questionnaire: NovaCorp cloud marketplace listing - initial upload

Tara — thanks for sending this over and for the timeline. We can meet the June 4 target with one caveat: security has a couple of clarifications around the tenant isolation / data residency workbook that could affect a final answer.

Proposed plan from our side:
1) We'll slot internal owners and return a first-pass completed questionnaire by Wed, 31 May (draft).
2) Security will review and we'll submit finalized answers + SOC2 summary by Fri, 4 Jun.
3) We'll provide a Mutual Action Plan and list of dependencies (billing contact, PoP for listing) by Mon, 7 Jun.

Marissa — can you confirm who on your side owns commercial terms and the DocuSign routing?
Stephanie — can you take point on the tenant isolation/arch answers? I attached the spreadsheet to a shared drive link for editing.

Also, quick question for procurement: does NovaCorp require carrier-of-record billing (you bill customers) or marketplace-mediated billing? That will determine a couple of cells in the commercial tab.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: (link to editable copy of Nova_RFP_Cloud_AWS_Azure_GCP.xlsx)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novacorp.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor questionnaire: NovaCorp cloud marketplace listing - initial upload

Hi Tara (and team),

Appreciate the template — attached is our first-pass response bundle and a short mutual action plan to keep tracking clean. Highlights and asks:

- Security evidence: included a one-page SOC2 summary. For the full report we can either provide a redacted copy under NDA or schedule a secure evidence transfer. Which do you prefer?
- Billing model: Redwood supports both marketplace-mediated billing and vendor-carried billing. For NovaCorp's marketplace, carrier-of-record would require a commercial integration window (est ~4 weeks) to wire invoices; marketplace-mediated reduces integration time but requires a revenue share flow.
- Technical clarifications: in the tenant isolation tab we note two optional deployment patterns (VPC-hosted vs. Private on-prem connector). Please confirm which pattern NovaCorp prefers for the initial listing — it changes the wording of the SLA and data handling cells.
- One ask from legal/procurement: can NovaCorp share a standard marketplace MSA or term sheet up-front? We can pre-review to reduce negotiation cycles.

We've attached: Redwood_RFI_Responses_v1.docx, SOC2-Summary.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx. We'll iterate quickly on the RFI if procurement/technical ask for more detail.

Next steps we propose:
- Karthik to confirm commercial owner + DocuSign route (today)
- Stephanie to finalize tenant isolation language and confirm redaction plan for SOC2 (by 4 Jun)
- Tara/procurement to share preferred billing model and marketplace MSA (if available)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0332

Attachments:
- Redwood_RFI_Responses_v1.docx (document, 42KB)
- SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf, 95KB)
- Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novacorp.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, legal@ncorp-legal.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor questionnaire: NovaCorp cloud marketplace listing - initial upload

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. A few clarifications after internal review: 

- SOC2: Procurement is fine with a redacted SOC2 under NDA. Legal has requested a short addendum for evidence transfer; copying legal now.
- Billing model: NovaCorp prefers marketplace-mediated billing for initial listings to streamline billing reconciliation. Please fill the commercial tab assuming marketplace-mediated (we'll follow-up if we need vendor-carried later).
- Deployment pattern: for the listing pilot we'd like the VPC-hosted option called out in the tech worksheet. That keeps onboarding consistent across pilots.
- DocuSign: legal asked whether Redwood prefers Redwood-initiated or NovaCorp-initiated routing. For speed, NovaCorp can initiate if you provide a contact for signature routing and the MSA template; otherwise Redwood can initiate and we'll accept.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday, May 31?
1) Finalized questionnaire (with commercial tab set to marketplace-mediated)
2) NDA + redacted SOC2 delivery plan
3) Preferred DocuSign routing contact

If those are in place we'll open the internal review and aim to provide the marketplace onboarding checklist and dates by June 7.

Thanks — copying our procurement and legal teams for visibility.

Best,
Tara
Sr. Vendor Manager, NovaCorp Marketplace
